tickets.text: Prepare a coordinated projection for Helena and Gabriel Thimblefern showing whether a partial Roth conversion still makes sense in a high-income year, incorporating Helena's Moonbadger Instruments bonus estimate, vested RSU shares, Gabriel's Copper Firefly Design Studio income range, and the household's charitable plans.

tickets.title: Coordinate Benefits Enrollment Support
tickets.text: Use this coordination template when a client needs help reviewing employer benefit choices, organizing enrollment materials, or confirming elections. Keep recommendations within advisory scope and document assumptions clearly. Helena Thimblefern needs a review of Moonbadger Instruments' available health plan, HSA, disability, life insurance, and 401(k) election choices before the employer portal closes, as the employer moved its benefits cycle.

subTasks.title: Gather enrollment materials
subTasks.text: Request the benefits guide, enrollment portal summary, plan options, employer contribution details, deadlines stated by the employer, and current elections. Store documents in the planning file.

subTasks.title: Review planning implications
subTasks.text: Analyze available retirement plan, health plan, HSA/FSA, disability, life insurance, and equity or deferred compensation options for planning relevance. Summarize tradeoffs and questions for the client discussion.

subTasks.title: Confirm client elections and documentation
subTasks.text: After the client makes selections, request confirmation of submitted elections or a benefits summary. Note any follow-up items for payroll, beneficiaries, or future plan updates.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete that benefits enrollment review by 2025-07-10.

tickets.title: Resolve Missing Signature Packet
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a form, agreement, authorization, or disclosure is otherwise complete but cannot proceed because one or more required signatures, initials, dates, or attestations are missing. Confirm the exact deficiency, contact the signer with clear instructions, and verify the corrected packet before filing or submission. The Silver Marmot Giving Fund charitable transfer packet for Helena and Gabriel Thimblefern is otherwise complete, but the spouse consent page and one donor acknowledgment page were not signed in the returned copy.

subTasks.title: Identify the signature gap
subTasks.text: Review the document packet and note each missing signature, initial, date, witness line, notary block, or required checkbox. Confirm whether electronic signature, wet signature, or custodian-specific signing is required.

subTasks.title: Send signer instructions
subTasks.text: Contact the client or authorized signer with the specific pages and fields needing completion. Include return instructions, acceptable delivery method, and any identity or witness requirements.

subTasks.title: Verify corrected packet
subTasks.text: After receipt, confirm the corrected pages are legible, complete, and consistent with the rest of the packet before updating the task status or forwarding for processing.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the missing signatures by 2025-07-01.

tickets.text: Request the current mortgage statement, note or loan summary, escrow details if applicable, interest rate, term, payment amount, and any refinance or payoff information needed for the planning file. Obtain the current mortgage statement for Helena and Gabriel Thimblefern's primary residence, showing escrow, payment allocation, and payoff information, to refresh the retirement cash-flow model; the mortgage balance is approximately $690,000 at a fixed 3.10% rate.

tickets.title: Review Insurance Policy Details

Note gaps, upcoming decisions, tax considerations, and coordination needed with the insurance professional or estate attorney. Review Helena Thimblefern's $1,000,000 and Gabriel Thimblefern's $750,000 Amber Teapot Insurance term life policies, which may no longer align with the $690,000 mortgage balance, retirement timing, and Rowan Thimblefern's remaining education period.
